sentences.text: On the evening of 19 December 1946, at about 8 p.m., the lights of Hà Nội went out across the city.
It was the signal for the fighting to begin.
Soldiers, self-defence units and ordinary residents had prepared the streets: trees were cut down, tram cars were left across the road, and furniture and bricks were piled into barricades.
Houses and street corners became linked strongpoints, and the fighting moved from street to street.
The defence lasted about sixty days and nights, from 19 December 1946 to 17 February 1947.
In January 1947 the Capital Regiment was formed.
In February, to keep its strength for the long war, it left the city, crossed the Red River and moved to a safe zone.
Hà Nội had held the enemy back and helped protect the leadership as it moved to the base area.
